Hi Jordan — great to meet you (virtually).

Thanks for the context. For GCP procurement and listing intake we typically need:
- Signed commercial terms / order form (DocuSign)
- PO (if the customer will use a PO billing path)
- W9/tax documentation for US companies
- SLA (if the customer requests custom SLA language)
- Listing manifest (yaml) and product images for the marketplace UI

I've copied the marketplace intake team. For DocuSign, use the standard GCP partner order form (I'll send a link). Please place the manifest and images in the Drive folder below and add me as viewer/commenter so I can verify.

DocuSign link (partner order): https://www.docusign.com/contract/abc123
Drive folder (suggested): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-gcp-listing-stratus
Procurement contact (if you need to route docs): procure-gcp@google.com

If Stratus will buy via PO, ask their procurement team to confirm the billing contact and PO cadence. If they prefer marketplace billing, we can enable a billing SKU during listing activation.

I can do a 20-min sync tomorrow afternoon (PST) to walk through the intake checklist and Docusign flow — what time works for you?

Best,
Lina
